text: The School's Chinese Language Training program is designed to provide long-term or short-term Chinese language teaching for foreigners who wish to improve their comprehensive Chinese language skills or for international students applying to study medicine at Ningxia Medical University. This program is based on the intensive teaching mode of small classes, so that international students can understand and integrate into Chinese culture in a short time, and have different levels of Chinese listening, speaking, reading and writing skills, and lay a good language foundation for future study and life in China.
